observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor public performance space with an audience sitting on the ground
observation.formation_and_space: solo on a red stage, addressing the audience and microphone
observation.posture: upright with semi-squat or deep knee bend stances, torso expressive and dynamic
observation.footwork: stamping, shifting weight in rhythm with the beat, intricate footwork obscured by heavy costume skirts
observation.arms_and_hands: expressive hand gestures (mudras), arms moving dynamically with bells on wrists
observation.hips_and_torso: bends, swaying, and expressive torso movements
observation.levels_jumps_turns: transitions between standing and kneeling/squatting levels, occasional turns
observation.costume_and_props: elaborate green facial makeup, ornate headdress, layered necklaces, striped skirt with large white ruffled fan-like bustle at the back, arm and wrist bands with bells
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details are obscured by the large layered skirt costume

signature_moments.what: The dancer stands with arms extended and ruffled bustle flaring, stepping in place on the stage.
The dancer turns around showing the large white ruffled bustle while making expressive hand gestures.
The dancer kneels on the stage near audience members, hands clasped near face in expressive storytelling pose.
The dancer bows forward with torso bent low, arms outstretched, shaking wrist bells.
The dancer folds arms across chest then brings hands together in a respectful prayer gesture near the microphone.
